user.title: Set up Wake Word Studio
user.description: Review, train and roll out your own wake words for ESPHome voice devices. Afterwards everything is under **Wake Word Studio** in the sidebar.

data_description.ordner: Folder for recordings, versions and settings. /share is included in Home Assistant backups. It is created if it does not exist.

reconfigure.title: Change storage folder
reconfigure.description: Currently: `{current}`. All recordings and versions move to the new folder; the old folder is deleted afterwards. If the new folder already holds Wake Word Studio data, that data is used instead.

data_description.ordner: Folder for recordings, versions and settings. /share is included in Home Assistant backups. It is created if it does not exist.

error.not_absolute: Please enter a full path starting with /.
error.not_allowed: This folder is not allowed (Home Assistant's own folders, for example custom_components or www).
error.not_writable: Home Assistant cannot write to this folder.
error.not_empty: The folder already contains other files. Choose an empty folder or one with Wake Word Studio data.
error.nested: The new folder must not be inside the current one (or the other way round).
error.move_failed: Moving the data failed; everything stays in the current folder. Details are in the log.

abort.already_configured: Wake Word Studio is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Wake Word Studio is already set up.
abort.unchanged: That is already the storage folder.

fetch_failed.message: Fetching recordings from the devices failed. Details are in the log.

device_missing.title: Device {device} not found
device_missing.description: The wake word **{word}** is assigned to the device `{device}`, but Home Assistant has not seen this ESPHome device for a while. If it was renamed or replaced, open Wake Word Studio → the word → Word → Devices and slot and choose the device again. If it is only switched off, this message disappears as soon as it is back.

trainer_missing.title: No trainer connected
trainer_missing.description: A training has been waiting for more than a day, but no trainer is connected. Start the trainer app or the Docker container; the instructions are in Wake Word Studio → [Settings]({panel}) → Trainer.

trainer_slow_memory.title: Trainer is slowed down
trainer_slow_memory.description: The trainer has been mostly waiting for memory (swap) for more than 15 minutes while the processor is hardly used. Training continues, but much slower. Typical causes: too little memory for the container (swap in use), or the trainer's data is on a network drive. Give the container more memory or move its disk to a local SSD. Details and load: Wake Word Studio → [Settings]({panel}) → Trainer. This message disappears by itself once the trainer runs smoothly again.

trainer_slow_disk.title: Trainer is slowed down
trainer_slow_disk.description: The trainer has been mostly waiting for the disk for more than 15 minutes while the processor is hardly used. Training continues, but much slower. Typical causes: too little memory for the container (swap in use), or the trainer's data is on a network drive. Give the container more memory or move its disk to a local SSD. Details and load: Wake Word Studio → [Settings]({panel}) → Trainer. This message disappears by itself once the trainer runs smoothly again.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: A new version of **{words}** has been saved. Home Assistant reads new wake word models when it starts. Restart now to roll it out? Afterwards the word is selected on its devices by itself.
